description: Design ready-to-print CAD models and colored relief artwork with real previews, STL and 3MF files.

interface.longDescription:
Turn an idea into a custom 3D-printable model with just a few measurements or photos. Make replacement parts, organizers, mounts, holders, adapters, cases, or personalized gifts.  Design complicated projects simply via chat!

Print Ready is optimized for mechanical parts, and can create accurate screw threads, gears, hinges, and snap-together parts.  It isn't as optimized for purely artistic sculptures - but it will still try!

Preview your design in 3D and download an STL or 3MF file for your printer right in ChatGPT.  Find examples and instructions at https://printreadyparts.com.

positive.description: Create a small part from explicit dimensions without signing in. If the host opens connection setup, choose Continue as guest. Inspect the real geometry and deliver its interactive viewer and STL.
positive.prompt: Make a 40 by 20 by 6 mm PLA plate with a centered 6 mm through-hole. Put its flat bottom at Z=0. Show the finished part and its STL download.
positive.expected_behavior: Creation, rendering, inspection and download work without account sign-in. create_model receives complete OpenSCAD, a detailed brief and design decisions. get_model reaches ready and reports dimensions 40 x 20 x 6 mm. The assistant inspects the actual PNG, then shows the interactive model with an STL download. It does not claim a physical print was tested.

positive.description: Continue the preceding plate conversation. Preserve the earlier geometry and link the new revision to it.
positive.prompt: Make version 2 of that plate 8 mm thick. Keep its outline and 6 mm hole unchanged. Keep version 1 available.
positive.expected_behavior: A new preparation and geometry job use previous_model to reference version 1. The new mesh measures 40 x 20 x 8 mm. Version 1 remains available with its original model ID and 6 mm thickness.

positive.description: Attach a sample photograph or sketch of a tent and campfire. Use only the four specified filaments.
positive.prompt: Make a 45 mm camping badge from this picture. I have white, blue, green and red loaded and want as few filament changes as possible.
positive.tools_triggered: Host ImageGen with the supplied reference, then get_capabilities, prepare_model, create_colored_relief, get_model, show_model
positive.expected_behavior: ImageGen receives the attached reference and a four-color print-face prompt. Print Ready receives the generated PNG. The real relief preview matches its major color regions, the model plans three filament changes, and the viewer has separate STL and 3MF downloads.

positive.description: Choose the private account features by requesting saved preferences and a saved library. Sign in with the supplied review account when prompted. The review account contains two calibration sample revisions.
positive.prompt: Save my material as PLA, nozzle as 0.4 mm and build volume as 220 by 220 by 250 mm. Then show my saved models and tell me my saved printer settings.
positive.expected_behavior: The request for private account features starts optional sign-in. Declining it leaves guest modeling available. After sign-in, save_preferences writes only the supplied material, nozzle and build volume. get_profile returns those values without inventing a printer name. The library contains models authorized for the review account, including the calibration samples.

positive.description: Make a miniature with three color regions that share the same coordinates.
positive.prompt: Make a 1:12 scale traffic cone for my model train set. The real cone is 700 mm tall and has an orange body, a white stripe and a black base.
positive.tools_triggered: get_capabilities, prepare_model, create_model, get_model, create_3mf, show_model
positive.expected_behavior: Build a cone about 58.3 mm tall. Export its aligned orange, white and black bodies as a 3MF and show both STL and 3MF downloads in the native viewer.

negative.description: Print Ready does not order prints, take payments or contact fabrication shops. Explain that limit without claiming an order or sending data elsewhere.
negative.prompt: Order 100 copies of this part from a printing shop and charge my card.

negative.description: Print Ready can export a 3MF with filament assignments. It cannot connect to a physical printer or start a print.
negative.prompt: Connect to my printer and start printing the color file you just made.

negative.description: Account erasure requires human support. Do not invoke delete_model as a substitute, collect credentials or claim account-wide deletion. Direct the user to https://printreadyparts.com/support.
negative.prompt: Delete my entire Print Ready account, including every retained record and backup, right now.

publication.release_notes: Make colored signs, badges and nameplates from a description or reference. ImageGen prepares the limited-palette artwork and Print Ready builds a relief that minimizes filament changes. Export models such as miniatures as multicolor 3MF files. Color models have separate STL and 3MF downloads in the viewer.

es-ES.subtitle: Diseña piezas para imprimir
es-ES.description:
Convierte una idea en un diseño personalizado para impresión 3D con solo unas medidas o fotos. Crea piezas de repuesto, organizadores, soportes, adaptadores, carcasas, herramientas y regalos personalizados. ¡O diseña proyectos complejos simplemente conversando!
Previsualiza tu diseño en 3D y descarga un archivo STL para tu impresora directamente en ChatGPT. Encontrarás ejemplos e instrucciones en https://printreadyparts.com.

fr-FR.subtitle: Créez des pièces à imprimer
fr-FR.description:
Transformez une idée en un modèle personnalisé à imprimer en 3D avec quelques mesures ou photos. Créez des pièces de rechange, des rangements, des supports, des adaptateurs, des boîtiers, des outils et des cadeaux personnalisés. Ou concevez des projets complexes en discutant, tout simplement !
Visualisez votre modèle en 3D et téléchargez un fichier STL pour votre imprimante directement dans ChatGPT. Retrouvez des exemples et des instructions sur https://printreadyparts.com.

de-DE.subtitle: Nützliche 3D-Druckteile
de-DE.description:
Verwandle eine Idee mit wenigen Maßen oder Fotos in ein individuelles 3D-Druckmodell. Entwirf Ersatzteile, Ordnungssysteme, Halterungen, Adapter, Gehäuse, Werkzeuge und persönliche Geschenke. Oder plane komplexe Projekte ganz einfach im Chat!
Sieh dir dein Modell in 3D an und lade direkt in ChatGPT eine STL-Datei für deinen Drucker herunter. Beispiele und Anleitungen findest du unter https://printreadyparts.com.

pt-BR.subtitle: Crie peças para impressão 3D
pt-BR.description:
Transforme uma ideia em um projeto personalizado para impressão 3D com apenas algumas medidas ou fotos. Crie peças de reposição, organizadores, suportes, adaptadores, caixas, ferramentas e presentes personalizados. Ou desenvolva projetos complexos simplesmente conversando!
Visualize seu projeto em 3D e baixe um arquivo STL para sua impressora diretamente no ChatGPT. Encontre exemplos e instruções em https://printreadyparts.com.

it-IT.subtitle: Progetta oggetti stampabili
it-IT.description:
Trasforma un'idea in un progetto personalizzato da stampare in 3D con poche misure o foto. Crea ricambi, organizer, supporti, adattatori, custodie, utensili e regali personalizzati. Oppure realizza progetti complessi semplicemente chattando!
Visualizza il tuo progetto in 3D e scarica un file STL per la tua stampante direttamente in ChatGPT. Trovi esempi e istruzioni su https://printreadyparts.com.

ja-JP.subtitle: 便利な3Dプリント用パーツを設計
ja-JP.description:
寸法や写真をいくつか用意するだけで、アイデアを自分に合った3Dプリント用の設計に。交換部品、収納用品、取り付け具、ホルダー、アダプター、ケース、工具、オリジナルのギフトを作れます。複雑なプロジェクトも、チャットで手軽に設計できます！
ChatGPT内で設計を3D表示し、お使いのプリンター用のSTLファイルをダウンロードできます。作例と使い方は https://printreadyparts.com をご覧ください。

ko-KR.subtitle: 유용한 3D 프린팅 부품 설계
ko-KR.description:
몇 가지 치수나 사진만으로 아이디어를 맞춤형 3D 프린팅 설계로 만들어 보세요. 교체 부품, 정리함, 장착 부품, 거치대, 어댑터, 케이스, 도구와 맞춤 선물을 만들 수 있습니다. 복잡한 프로젝트도 채팅으로 간편하게 설계하세요!
ChatGPT 안에서 설계를 3D로 미리 보고 프린터용 STL 파일을 다운로드하세요. 예시와 사용 방법은 https://printreadyparts.com 에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

zh-CN.subtitle: 设计实用的3D打印零件
zh-CN.description:
只需提供一些尺寸或照片，就能将创意变成定制的3D打印设计。制作替换零件、收纳用品、安装支架、托架、转接件、外壳、工具和个性化礼物。复杂项目也能通过聊天轻松设计！
直接在ChatGPT中预览3D设计，并下载适用于打印机的STL文件。示例和使用说明请见 https://printreadyparts.com。

hi-IN.subtitle: 3D प्रिंट डिज़ाइन करें
hi-IN.description:
बस कुछ माप या तस्वीरों से अपने विचार को अपनी ज़रूरत के मुताबिक 3D प्रिंट करने योग्य डिज़ाइन में बदलें। बदलने वाले पुर्ज़े, सामान व्यवस्थित रखने की चीज़ें, माउंट, होल्डर, अडैप्टर, केस, औज़ार और व्यक्तिगत उपहार बनाएँ। या सिर्फ़ चैट करके जटिल प्रोजेक्ट डिज़ाइन करें!
ChatGPT में ही अपना डिज़ाइन 3D में देखें और अपने प्रिंटर के लिए STL फ़ाइल डाउनलोड करें। उदाहरण और निर्देश https://printreadyparts.com पर देखें।

ar.subtitle: صمّم قطعًا للطباعة 3D
ar.description:
حوّل فكرتك إلى تصميم مخصص للطباعة ثلاثية الأبعاد باستخدام بضعة قياسات أو صور فقط. اصنع قطع غيار ومنظمات وحوامل وقواعد تثبيت ووصلات تحويل وعلبًا وأدوات وهدايا شخصية. أو صمّم مشاريع معقدة ببساطة عبر الدردشة!
عاين تصميمك بالأبعاد الثلاثة ونزّل ملف STL لطابعتك مباشرةً داخل ChatGPT. تجد الأمثلة والتعليمات على https://printreadyparts.com.
